info.name: Blink Charging & Status API (BlinkMap API) Locations Search API
Search charging station locations by name

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text search query (e.g. a location or site name).

params.name: lat
params.description: Reference latitude used to bias/scope results.

params.name: lng
params.description: Reference longitude used to bias/scope results.

items.docs: Returns Blink-compatible charging station locations matching a text query, scoped by a reference latitude/longitude. Modeled from the Search endpoint of the historical BlinkMap API.
